verified.title: Offline cash-order replay abandons an order that already SUCCEEDED (409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT mis-handled as retryable failure)
verified.file_line: resources/js/helpers/kioskOfflineQueue.js:561-587 (generic catch — no 409 special-case); _payloadWithFreshQuote re-quote at :370-393; abandon threshold MAX_ATTEMPTS=10 at :16 + :565; order_abandoned telemetry at _reportAbandoned :340-348. Server-side 409 source: app/Http/Middleware/IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php:76 (payloadHash=sha256(body)) + :88-93 (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT 409 on payloadHash mismatch). Offline-queue trigger: resources/js/store/modules/kioskCart.js:774-797 (CASH-only network-error path strips quote_token/signature/total, preserves idempotencyKey as localKey).
verified.reproduction: 1) Place a CASH kiosk order; the server commits but the 2xx ACK is lost (TCP reset / proxy timeout). kioskCart.js:774 sees !err.response → isNetworkError; line 776 rejects ELECTRONIC methods, so CASH falls through and is queued offline (lines 788-797 strip quote fields, saveOrder preserves idempotencyKey=localKey). 2) syncQueue (kioskOfflineQueue.js:529-588) replays: _payloadWithFreshQuote (:370-393) POSTs /frontend/order/quote → NEW quote_token/signature/total → re-POSTs /frontend/order with X-Idempotency-Key=localKey but a DIFFERENT body. 3) IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php:88 finds the cached entry whose payloadHash != new body hash → returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT (:92-93). 4) syncQueue catch (:561) treats 409 as a generic failure: failed+=1, attempts++; after MAX_ATTEMPTS=10 (:16,:565) marks entry abandoned (:571-574) and fires offline.abandoned + later order_abandoned (_reportAbandoned :340-348). Net: the order IS in the kitchen (PENDING_COUNTER auto-accepted) but the borne logged it abandoned and surfaced no queue number.
verified.reasoning: A 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT on a replay carrying the SAME idempotency key proves the original POST already completed server-side — it is success-via-conflict, not failure. Retrying it to abandonment is semantically backwards: it emits false order_abandoned telemetry into the very offline-failure dashboards KioskEventController feeds, and leaves a permanently-abandoned IndexedDB entry that getAbandonedCount surfaces forever. On a single-box LAN the lost-ACK window is rare → not production-blocking (P2), but it is a real correctness bug in the offline-resilience feature. Fix is local + safe: kioskOfflineQueue.js is NON-frozen.
decomposed_tasks: In syncQueue catch (kioskOfflineQueue.js:561), special-case error.response?.status===409 with body code IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT (or the X-Idempotency-Conflict response header) as TERMINAL SUCCESS: increment synced, do NOT push to remaining, emit an offline.replayed-via-conflict track event. Acceptance: a replay returning 409 removes the entry and counts as synced (result.synced+=1, result.failed unchanged).
Assert the cached 2xx replay path (200/201 + X-Idempotency-Replayed header) already drops the entry as success. Acceptance: a 201 replay leaves the queue empty, synced+=1.

Guard _reportAbandoned / order_abandoned (kioskOfflineQueue.js:340-348, :566) so entries terminated via 409-success are NOT counted as abandonedNew. Acceptance: in the 409 scenario abandonedNew===0 and no frontend/kiosk-event with type:'order_abandoned' is POSTed.

verified.title: Parked-order recall is a destructive, non-idempotent GET → a lost response / retried GET permanently loses the parked ticket (hard delete, no SoftDeletes)
verified.file_line: routes/api.php:924 (Route::get('/{id}', [ParkedOrderController::class,'show'])) — supervisor cited :911, ACTUAL is :924; app/Http/Controllers/Admin/Pos/ParkedOrderController.php:48-58 show() calls service->recall(); app/Services/PosParkedOrderService.php recall() does lockForUpdate() then $parked->delete() inside DB::transaction returning the in-memory snapshot; app/Models/PosParkedOrder.php has NO SoftDeletes trait / no deleted_at (HARD delete); client resources/js/store/modules/posParked.js:81 recall() = axios.get(`admin/pos/parked-orders/${id}`). IdempotencyKeyMiddleware guards POST mutating routes, not this GET.
verified.reproduction: Cashier parks an order (POST /parked-orders). Recall issues GET /admin/pos/parked-orders/{id} → server hard-deletes the PosParkedOrder row and returns the snapshot. If the response is lost before the client receives it (tab reload mid-request is the realistic single-box vector; proxy-retry/network-blip vectors do not exist on localhost) and the cashier retries GET /parked-orders/{id} → row already deleted → recall() returns null → controller returns 404 {'error':'not_found'}. The staged cart is permanently gone; cashier must re-key it.
verified.reasoning: REAL & CONFIRMED — destructive hard-delete on an idempotent HTTP verb (GET), no SoftDeletes, no recovery. SEVERITY CALIBRATED TO V1-LOCAL: this is the BRAIN §2 M7-02 / Phase-2 audit finding 'NEW GET /parked supprime la ligne = non-idempotent retry=404'. Downgraded from the supervisor's P1 to P2 because in the single-box LOCAL envelope the proxy/network-retry vectors in the supplied reproduction don't apply; the only realistic trigger is tab-reload-mid-recall (rare), and the blast radius is re-keying a staged cart — nothing fiscal or persistent is destroyed (no order/receipt/Z is created at park/recall time). Kept in (not dropped) because the design flaw — permanent data loss on a retryable verb with no SoftDeletes — is genuine and confirmed code, just not production-blocking in V1.
decomposed_tasks: Make recall non-destructive on the GET, OR move the delete to an explicit idempotent-safe step. Option A: split into GET (read snapshot, do NOT delete) + DELETE /{id} (the existing destroy route) fired by the client only after the cart is successfully restored client-side. Option B: keep single-call recall but add SoftDeletes to PosParkedOrder so a retry can recover the (just-deleted) row within a grace window. Acceptance: a second GET for the same id after a lost-response returns the same snapshot, not 404.
If SoftDeletes added: add deleted_at migration + restore/recovery path; ensure listForOperator still excludes recalled tickets; respect BranchScope (model already global-scoped).
Update resources/js/store/modules/posParked.js recall() to the chosen flow (e.g. GET-then-DELETE-on-success) so a failed restore does not orphan-delete the ticket.
Add regression test: park → recall (response dropped) → recall again → snapshot still returned (or row soft-recoverable).

all_findings.title: Offline cash-order replay abandons an order that already SUCCEEDED (409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT mis-handled as retryable failure)
all_findings.file_line: resources/js/helpers/kioskOfflineQueue.js:561-587 (generic catch — no 409 special-case); _payloadWithFreshQuote re-quote at :370-393; abandon threshold MAX_ATTEMPTS=10 at :16 + :565; order_abandoned telemetry at _reportAbandoned :340-348. Server-side 409 source: app/Http/Middleware/IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php:76 (payloadHash=sha256(body)) + :88-93 (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT 409 on payloadHash mismatch). Offline-queue trigger: resources/js/store/modules/kioskCart.js:774-797 (CASH-only network-error path strips quote_token/signature/total, preserves idempotencyKey as localKey).
all_findings.reproduction: 1) Place a CASH kiosk order; the server commits but the 2xx ACK is lost (TCP reset / proxy timeout). kioskCart.js:774 sees !err.response → isNetworkError; line 776 rejects ELECTRONIC methods, so CASH falls through and is queued offline (lines 788-797 strip quote fields, saveOrder preserves idempotencyKey=localKey). 2) syncQueue (kioskOfflineQueue.js:529-588) replays: _payloadWithFreshQuote (:370-393) POSTs /frontend/order/quote → NEW quote_token/signature/total → re-POSTs /frontend/order with X-Idempotency-Key=localKey but a DIFFERENT body. 3) IdempotencyKeyMiddleware.php:88 finds the cached entry whose payloadHash != new body hash → returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT (:92-93). 4) syncQueue catch (:561) treats 409 as a generic failure: failed+=1, attempts++; after MAX_ATTEMPTS=10 (:16,:565) marks entry abandoned (:571-574) and fires offline.abandoned + later order_abandoned (_reportAbandoned :340-348). Net: the order IS in the kitchen (PENDING_COUNTER auto-accepted) but the borne logged it abandoned and surfaced no queue number.
all_findings.reasoning: A 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT on a replay carrying the SAME idempotency key proves the original POST already completed server-side — it is success-via-conflict, not failure. Retrying it to abandonment is semantically backwards: it emits false order_abandoned telemetry into the very offline-failure dashboards KioskEventController feeds, and leaves a permanently-abandoned IndexedDB entry that getAbandonedCount surfaces forever. On a single-box LAN the lost-ACK window is rare → not production-blocking (P2), but it is a real correctness bug in the offline-resilience feature. Fix is local + safe: kioskOfflineQueue.js is NON-frozen.

Acceptance: a replay returning 409 removes the entry and counts as synced (result.synced+=1, result.failed unchanged).
Assert the cached 2xx replay path (200/201 + X-Idempotency-Replayed header) already drops the entry as success. Acceptance: a 201 replay leaves the queue empty, synced+=1.

Guard _reportAbandoned / order_abandoned (kioskOfflineQueue.js:340-348, :566) so entries terminated via 409-success are NOT counted as abandonedNew. Acceptance: in the 409 scenario abandonedNew===0 and no frontend/kiosk-event with type:'order_abandoned' is POSTed.

all_findings.reproduction: Cashier parks an order (POST /parked-orders). Recall issues GET /admin/pos/parked-orders/{id} → server hard-deletes the PosParkedOrder row and returns the snapshot. The finding's own decomposed task #1 says 'if branch-staff -> DOWNGRADE to P3 doc-only.' Whether admin-on-KDS is the real operator habit cannot be confirmed from code and is contrary to the seeded purpose-built accounts; per the conservative mandate (a false P1 is worse than a missed P2) the only actionable, in-envelope residue is a one-line runbook confirmation.
